title: Oil Change Tracking Log
subtitle: Engine Oil-Change Service: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Oil Change Tracking Log covers vehicle, engine, oil specification, filter, drain and fill points, fluid level, and service interval. The maintenance service advisor records Engine Oil-Change Service events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Oil Change Tracking Log keeps Engine Oil-Change Service exceptions visible until the maintenance service advisor handoff.
use_case: Use Oil Change Tracking Log at service lane, lift bay, engine compartment, and customer handoff. Document vehicle, engine, oil specification, filter, drain and fill points, fluid level, and service interval identity before Engine Oil-Change Service begins. Compare vehicle, engine, oil specification, filter, drain and fill points, fluid level, and service interval findings with stated Engine Oil-Change Service criteria; route unresolved Engine Oil-Change Service issues to qualified automotive maintenance reviewer. For Oil Change Tracking Log, confirm requirements for Engine Oil-Change Service. Ask qualified automotive maintenance reviewer to review Engine Oil-Change Service conditions beyond the maintenance service advisor's role.

sections.title: Tracking review and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Engine Oil-Change Service, identify responsible parties, service lane, lift bay, engine compartment, and customer handoff, and the linked vehicle, engine, oil specification, filter, drain and fill points, fluid level, and service interval source.

fields.label: VIN, plate, year, make, model, and mileage
Engine, oil specification, capacity, filter, and interval

sections.title: Status variance and accountable response
sections.guidance: Capture Engine Oil-Change Service facts for vehicle, engine, oil specification, filter, drain and fill points, fluid level, and service interval; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Engine Oil-Change Service tracked controls
items: Pre-service oil level and visible leak condition
Drain plug, pan, filter housing, and sealing surface
Measured fill quantity and final level
Maintenance indicator reset and next interval

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: Reconcile the latest Engine Oil-Change Service event before closeout. Maintenance Service Advisor identifies overdue action, the responsible party, and the event that reopens review.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Final level or leak check cannot be verified
Drain, filter, quantity, and final-level record
Post-service leak check and interval notice
blocks.guidance: Pause Engine Oil-Change Service when oil specification, sealing integrity, active leak, final level, or operating verification remains unresolved. Retain the available Engine Oil-Change Service proof and route unresolved vehicle, engine, oil specification, filter, drain and fill points, fluid level, and service interval scope to maintenance service advisor.
